Here’s a compilation of some super simple, yet tasty and satisfying recipes to help out budding DIY mixologists get their feet wet in their new hobby. If you're looking for inspiration or even just a general idea of what to buy on your first (or second, or third) order, here’s a few quickies that are simple and easy to make.

There’s a couple of them, so I've gone ahead and separated them into categories for easier look-up.

Also, remember that everything is subjective! If you want, for example, your Strawberry-Banana to taste less like Strawberry and more like Banana, adjust the ratios to your preferences and experiment. These are just some of the one-off’s and super simple recipe ideas, nothing is set in stone and everything is adjustable.

(Abbreviations: TFA: The Flavor (Perfumer's) Apprentice / FA: FlavourArt / CAP: Capella’s / FW: Flavor West / LA: LorAnn’s Oils)

Tobaccos:

Burley Ship

5% Desert Ship (FA)

4% Burley Tobacco (FA)

The Cowboy

2% Western (Cowboy) (TFA)

3% Oakwood (FA)

‘Murica

2% USA Blend Tobacco (FW)

1% Western (Cowboy) (TFA)

Note - both of these are quite potent, a little dab’ll do ya

Seven Black

4% 7 Leaves Tobacco (FA)

4% Perique Black (FA)

Perique Fire

3% Perique Black (FA)

3% Black Fire (FA)

Kinda Tastes Like Tobacco, Actually

4% Desert Ship (FA)

3% Tuscan Ultimate Reserve (FA)

3% 7 Leaves Tobacco (FA)

Mellow Pipe

3% Burley Tobacco (FA)

5% Coumarin Pipe Tobacco (FW)

Fruits

Strawberry-Banana

5% Strawberry (TFA)

2% Ripe Banana (TFA)

Sprite & Apple

4% Lemon Lime (TFA)

2% Granny Smith Apple (TFA)

Apple-dew Melon

5% Granny Smith Apple (TFA)

2% Honeydew Melon (TFA)

Tropical-ish Medley

3% Coconut (FA)

3% Strawberry (TFA)

3% Ecto-Cooler (FW)

Apple-Pom

4% Apple (LA)

2% Pomegranete (LA)

Cherry ‘n Berry

3% Black Cherry (TFA)

3% Blackberry (TFA)

Mints, Drinks, etc

Wintermix

5% Wintergreen (TFA)

1.5% Peppermint (FA)

Gas Station Splurge

4% Monstrous (FW)

2% Lemon Lime (TFA)

PBJ

2% Peanut Butter (LA)

4% Strawberry (TFA)

-or- 4% Blackberry (TFA)

Fruity Yogurt

4% Yogurt (FA)

-or- 4% Greek Yogurt (TFA)

3% White Peach (FA)

-or- 3% Blackberry (TFA)

-or- 4% Strawberry (TFA)

-or- 3% Apple (LA)

(you get the gist...)

Like I said earlier, nothing is ever set in stone. These are just some reference starting and mixing numbers for people really early into it, or people just trying to find a not-so-complex, easy to mix flavor combo they'll enjoy.

If I could convince anyone interested in trying one of these out of one thing, it'd be this: make it your own. Use it as a base, throw a little Ripe Banana (TFA) into that PBJ. Ethyl Maltol and TA (Tobacco Absolute, heavily diluted) are Tobacco blends' best friends. Koolada will make any of those fruits or the mint mix just snap with some minty throat chill. That Tropical-ish Medley? Toss in 1%, just a splash, of Pineapple (FW) or Mango (LA). Do something cool with it.

If anyone out there has any of their favorite simple recipes they'd like to add to the list, please add them! Share and encourage your mixing buddies to do the same - when everyone shares, everyone learns, everyone gets better and everyone is happier. Good luck, see ya in the comments.
